style: One small premium transparent editorial vignette for Alibi, a calm coastal puzzle club. subjects: A handsome brass magnifying glass resting diagonally beside two blank cream index cards, one small teal tab and a single pencil mark-like line of decoration on the outer card edge (no actual writing).
